nodes.name: Schedule_Trigger_15Min
nodes.notes: Autonomous 15-minute scheduler checking for upcoming confirmed appointments needing reminders

parameters.query:
WITH due_candidates AS (
      SELECT 
        a.appointment_id,
        CASE 
          WHEN a.start_time <= NOW() + INTERVAL '3 days' AND a.start_time > NOW() + INTERVAL '1 day' 
               AND a.reminder_3d_sent = FALSE 
               AND (a.reminder_3d_claimed_at IS NULL OR a.reminder_3d_claimed_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 minutes') THEN '3D'
          WHEN a.start_time <= NOW() + INTERVAL '1 day' AND a.start_time > NOW() + INTERVAL '4 hours' 
               AND a.reminder_1d_sent = FALSE 
               AND (a.reminder_1d_claimed_at IS NULL OR a.reminder_1d_claimed_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 minutes') THEN '1D'
          WHEN a.start_time <= NOW() + INTERVAL '4 hours' AND a.start_time > NOW() + INTERVAL '1 hour' 
               AND a.reminder_4h_sent = FALSE 
               AND (a.reminder_4h_claimed_at IS NULL OR a.reminder_4h_claimed_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 minutes') THEN '4H'
          WHEN a.start_time <= NOW() + INTERVAL '1 hour' AND a.start_time > NOW() 
               AND a.reminder_1h_sent = FALSE 
               AND (a.reminder_1h_claimed_at IS NULL OR a.reminder_1h_claimed_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 minutes') THEN '1H'
          ELSE NULL
        END AS tier
      FROM appointments a
      WHERE a.status = 'CONFIRMED'
    ),
    valid_due AS (
      SELECT appointment_id, tier FROM due_candidates WHERE tier IS NOT NULL
    )
    UPDATE appointments a
    SET 
      reminder_3d_claimed_at = CASE WHEN v.tier = '3D' THEN NOW() ELSE a.reminder_3d_claimed_at END,
      reminder_1d_claimed_at = CASE WHEN v.tier = '1D' THEN NOW() ELSE a.reminder_1d_claimed_at END,
      reminder_4h_claimed_at = CASE WHEN v.tier = '4H' THEN NOW() ELSE a.reminder_4h_claimed_at END,
      reminder_1h_claimed_at = CASE WHEN v.tier = '1H' THEN NOW() ELSE a.reminder_1h_claimed_at END
    FROM valid_due v
    JOIN doctors d ON a.doctor_id = d.doctor_id
    WHERE a.appointment_id = v.appointment_id
    RETURNING 
      a.appointment_id, a.customer_name, a.phone, a.doctor_id, a.service, 
      a.start_time, a.end_time, a.status,
      d.doctor_name, d.timezone, v.tier AS reminder_tier;

nodes.name: Send_WhatsApp_Reminder
nodes.notes: Only flows to Mark_Sent upon verified HTTP 200 WhatsApp delivery

parameters.query:
UPDATE appointments
    SET reminder_3d_sent = CASE WHEN $1 = '3D' THEN TRUE ELSE reminder_3d_sent END,
        reminder_1d_sent = CASE WHEN $1 = '1D' THEN TRUE ELSE reminder_1d_sent END,
        reminder_4h_sent = CASE WHEN $1 = '4H' THEN TRUE ELSE reminder_4h_sent END,
        reminder_1h_sent = CASE WHEN $1 = '1H' THEN TRUE ELSE reminder_1h_sent END,
        updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE appointment_id = $2;
